text: Level three, question seven: a sum becomes four times itself in fifteen years at simple interest; in how many years will it become seven times itself? Question eight: ten thousand rupees is split into two parts, invested at five percent and eight percent simple interest; the total interest in one year is six hundred and fifty rupees; find the two parts. Question nine: if the rate had been two percent higher, a sum would have earned three hundred and sixty rupees more in three years; find the sum.
